extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open ExTrans" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: In your meeting, choose "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" as the microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Kutumia ExTrans, chagua "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako.

wherebyGuidance.message: Kutumia ExTrans, tafadhali chagua "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio ya kipaza sauti chako na lemaza kupunguza kelele kwa utendaji bora zaidi.

defaultGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use ExTrans, please select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use ExTrans in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsTitle.message: ExTrans kwa ajili ya Microsoft Teams

teamsGuidance.message:
Ikiwa huoni orodha kamili ya vifaa vya sauti katika mipangilio ya Teams:
1) Zima kwa muda ugani wa ExTrans na onyesha upya ukurasa
2) Ruhusu Teams kufikia maikrofoni na kamera yako unapoombwa
3) Washa tena ugani wa ExTrans na onyesha upya ukurasa tena
4) Ruhusu ExTrans kufikia maikrofoni yako unapoombwa. Sasa unapaswa kuona vifaa halisi na "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" katika mipangilio yako.

jitsiGuidance.message: Ili kutumia ExTrans katika Jitsi Meet, fungua Settings > Devices na uchague "ExTrans Virtual Microphone" kama maikrofoni yako. Kisha fungua Advanced audio settings na uzime Noise suppression, Echo cancellation, na Automatic gain control kwa sauti ya tafsiri iliyo wazi.

desktopCtaBody.message: Maikrofoni wa kawaida wa mfumo mzima kwa OBS, YouTube, Twitch na programu yoyote ya desktop. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Unapenda kivinjari? ExTrans inafanya kazi kwenye tovuti hizi — bofya kufungua:

detectFailBody.message: Onyesha upya ukurasa na ufungue ExTrans tena.
